    Lemma A.1(1): signed coefficients on a periodic star model #

    lem:periodic-scalar-gauges (1) (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex). Let π : ℤΔ → Q be a covering of a star model commuting with translation, whose fibres are the orbits of g (v, t) = (σ v, t + c₀), with σ fixing the centre. Every coefficient system c on Q becomes the signed preprojective one after rescaling arrows and entire mesh relations: the scales of StarGauge are g-invariant, so they descend to Q.
